personality_one_liner: A calm, authoritative, and human-centered health awareness experience built on editorial clarity and organic warmth.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous vertical breathing room and magazine-like spacing rhythms with structured editorial containers.

do's: Use clean paper-like surfaces and calm editorial dividers.
dont's: Avoid heavy drop shadows and neon glows.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure authentication and registration with email/password and development OTP simulation.

states.empty: Enter your email and password to access your health awareness profile.
states.error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials or register.

screens.layout: Clean, editorial form with generous padding, clear validation states, and smooth tab switching between sign-in and registration.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Core overview displaying the user's latest Pulse Score, attention flags, and daily check-in status.

states.empty: No assessment data found. Complete your initial health assessment to generate your Pulse Score.
states.error: Unable to fetch health metrics. Please retry.

screens.layout: Vertical magazine feed with hero Pulse Score card, attention flag indicators, quick action buttons, and recent timeline summaries.

screens.name: Assessment
screens.purpose: Interactive health awareness questionnaire generating versioned Pulse Scores and attention rules.

states.error: Failed to submit assessment answers. Please verify and retry.

screens.layout: Step-by-step editorial questionnaire with clear progress indicators and instant score calculation on completion.

screens.name: Pulse60
screens.purpose: Daily 60-second check-ins tracking streaks, timezones, and seven-day progress.

states.empty: No check-ins recorded for this week yet.
states.error: Failed to record daily check-in. Please try again.

screens.layout: Card-based streak counter with interactive daily check-in button and 7-day progress visualization.

screens.name: Timeline & Uploads
screens.purpose: Private health document and report storage with secure download endpoints and validation metadata.

states.empty: No health reports uploaded yet. Upload your first medical document securely.
states.error: Failed to upload document. Please check file format and size.

screens.layout: Chronological list of uploaded medical reports with secure download tokens, thumbnail preview cards, and upload action modal.

screens.name: Doctors & Appointments
screens.purpose: Doctor directory and appointment request management with status tracking.

states.empty: No doctors available in the directory right now.
states.error: Failed to load appointments or doctor list.

screens.layout: Card list of verified healthcare providers with specialty badges, direct appointment booking sheet, and pending status tracker.

screens.name: Community
screens.purpose: Community discovery, membership, discussions, and moderated health awareness posts.

states.empty: No posts in this community yet. Be the first to share a health awareness topic.

screens.layout: Feed of community posts with author badges, like/comment actions, membership toggle, and report/moderation tools.

screens.name: Settings & Consent
screens.purpose: User profile management, consent grant/revoke controls, and privacy settings.

states.loading: Loading your profile and consent settings...

screens.layout: Clean editorial settings list with explicit consent toggles, profile details editor, and secure logout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing routes, database integration in backend/server.py, and frontend components in frontend/app/.
Ensure all screens follow Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality with warm terracotta accents, Playfair Display headers, and Satoshi body typography.
Implement loading, empty, and error states on every data-driven screen.
Adhere to touch targets >= 44x44pt and safe area insets at every screen root.
Ensure all text rendered over images uses the required 3-stop vertical scrim gradient for contrast.
